---
title: 'Circular Rejoin in 3D Using Bézier Paths'
authors:
  - 'Isaac E Weintraub'
  - 'Zachary J L Demers'
  - 'Jason Shroyer'
  - 'Nathan P Ritsema'
  - 'Dillon P Sluss'
year: '2020'
doi: '10.1109/CCTA41146.2020.9206385'
url: 'https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/842fb509a50adafbe4499ceebe79eadaa7b628e3'
image: 'images/publications/weintraub2020circular.jpg'
abstract: |
  In this paper, the interception of a target vehicle is presented utilizing a
  Bézier path. Utilizing the Bézier path, the controlled vehicle is navigated
  from an initial point and velocity vector to a desired target waypoint and
  velocity vector. To ensure a flyable path, control points of the Bézier are
  adjusted using a nonlinear program that takes into account maximum path
  curvature and vehicle performance criteria. A model predictive controller is
  designed to provide the real-time controls that drive the controlled vehicle
  along the Bézier path with minimal flight path error and control effort. A
  numerical simulation, which demonstrates the ability to navigate to a desired
  waypoint and velocity vector for circular rejoin, is provided as an example.
